scope: Explicit physical-compatibility proposals for current missing_scene_summary only; not final admission or numeric/recipe transfer. Own-produced source artwork still requires independent target-binding decision.

proposals.notes: Selected original standard cap is locked under the upright coffee-loaded chamber on a sturdy mug; the filter medium is wholly hidden. Thus a neutral assembled-preparation alt does not claim paper versus compatible metal. No quantities, cap material change, or pressure cap transferred. Producer is this agent, so target-binding proposal requires parent independent confirmation; prior image QC was independent.

proposals.notes: Clean basket fitted to portafilter is exactly the clean-basket portion of generic preparation. No machine controls, numerical capacity, basket label or calibrated dose shown. Only preparation of the clean basket is covered; measured coffee is not yet added and must remain instruction. Do not inherit source's single-wall/two-cup labels into generic alt. Producer is this agent; parent independent target-binding confirmation required.

proposals.notes: espresso_start/stop picture a specific control panel and finger pressing a specific button. Generic target delegates operating controls to the actual machine manual; no button selection can safely transfer. Generate a cropped group/spouts-to-cup-on-scale flow view with controls excluded.

Ground-puck removal into a knock box is the cleaning portion of generic completion with no controls, dose or basket capacity. This is not a served-cup illustration or all manufacturer cleaning operations. Serving and safe depressurization/cooling stay textual. Producer is this agent; parent independent target-binding confirmation required.

proposals.notes: Cold off-heat cutaway explicitly exposes ample expansion space and attached handle on stable heat-safe support. Target does not require an empty pot. No specific vessel capacity or coffee/water measurement transfers. It does not demonstrate an actual handle-security test or verify burner compatibility; accompanying checks remain. Proposed for both reviewed prepare and generic select-capacity as an illustrative headroom check, never proof of capacity.

proposals.notes: Existing01 cezve images already contain coffee/water mixture; none shows a separate cold-water addition. Stirring or a completed mixture would not explain this selected action.

Foam visibly rising below the rim over low contained heat is the exact physical observation requested. It implies neither a second rise nor a fixed temperature/time. Generic target owns when to remove and selected recipe; no repeated-rise instruction transfers.
proposals.alt: Foam rising toward the neck of a cezve over a low flame contained beneath its base.

proposals.notes: No existing source inspected shows sugar entering the cold pot. Optional sugar in source prose is not image evidence.
Gravity01 already contains coffee. Other sources hide contents or show a brewing/finished state; none demonstrates clean dry empty supported chamber.
Target says before adding anything. All supported open source chambers contain coffee; do not transfer a loaded/active state as empty setup.
No existing inspected source shows coffee being added to a neutral phin with insert mechanism excluded. Gravity01 shows loaded state plus loose gravity disc; screw01 exposes threads.
Gravity01 has a level bed but explicitly displays the separate gravity insert, while screw01 displays pillar/threaded insert. These violate this draft's mechanism-neutral condition.

Legacy prewet views show the insert in the open chamber, and retained-fill cutaways expose it further. Under the draft's explicit no screw/gravity mechanism criterion none is an exact neutral reuse. A higher external cropped opaque chamber pour can hide internals.

The source needs to explain selection-specific fitting while generic method permits either type. Existing gravity/screw images teach one concrete mechanism. A deliberately paired two-type conceptual illustration with appropriate documented-selection text needs independent QC; one undisclosed type is not neutral.

Opaque closed chamber hides insert mechanism, and downward drops collect into a stable clear cup showing concentrate. No serving additions/controls/numeric capacity appear. Image shows collection ongoing, not final-drip completion.

proposals.notes: Closed opaque chamber hides mechanism and the last visible drop over collected coffee illustrates observing the drip tail before removal. Must retain 'wait until flow stops' text: this is the observation while waiting, not proof that dripping has already stopped. If target admission requires a no-drop completed state, new art is required.
